name: PM Vishwakarma Scheme
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises

eligibility.other_conditions: Engaged in one of 18 recognized traditional trades using hands and tools. Minimum age 18 years. Family member should not be a government employee.

benefits: Recognition via PM Vishwakarma Certificate & ID Card, 5-7 days basic skill training with Rs 500/day stipend, Rs 15,000 modern toolkit incentive, and collateral-free enterprise credit up to Rs 3 Lakh at 5% concessional interest rate.
application_process: Biometric authentication and registration at nearest Common Service Centre (CSC).
Three-step verification: Gram Panchayat / Urban Local Body -> District Implementation Committee -> Screening Committee.
Issue of PM Vishwakarma Digital Certificate and disbursement of training stipend.
